name: handler_ascii_alert
title: Progression Handler: Progress Reported as ASCII BEL Symbols (Audio or Blink) in the Terminal

origin.description: Report progress by writing a BEL character, or another symbol, to a connection.
origin.usage: handler_ascii_alert(symbol = "\a", file = stderr(), intrusiveness = getOption("progressr.intrusiveness.audio", 5), target = c("terminal", "audio"), ...)

arguments.name: symbol
arguments.text: The text written for a non-zero update. The default is the BEL character.

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: A connection. The default is stderr().

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default is the option progressr.intrusiveness.audio, or 5.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is terminal and audio.

origin.details: update writes the symbol when the handler is enabled and the amount is not 0. interrupt writes a blank line, the condition message, and a blank line. hide and unhide do nothing.
origin.example:
path <- tempfile("al")
con <- file(path, open = "wt")
handler <- handler_ascii_alert(symbol = "!", file = con, enable = TRUE, intrusiveness = 1)
with_progress({
  p <- progressor(steps = 2, on_exit = FALSE)
  p(message = "a")
  p(amount = 0, message = "skip")
  p(message = "b")
}, handlers = handler, enable = TRUE, interval = 0, delay_terminal = FALSE, delay_stdout = FALSE, delay_conditions = character())
close(con)
cat("handler_ascii_alert wrote ", nchar(readChar(path, 100, useBytes = TRUE)), " bells.\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Report progress by writing a BEL character, or another symbol, to a text stream.

arguments.name: symbol
arguments.text: The text written for a non-zero update. The default is the BEL character.

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: A text stream with write(). The default is sys.stderr.

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default is the option progressr.intrusiveness.audio, or 5.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is terminal and audio.

arguments.name: extra
arguments.text: Further arguments passed to make_progression_handler(), including enable.

translation.details: update writes the symbol when the handler is enabled and the amount is not 0. interrupt writes a blank line, the condition message, and a blank line. hide and unhide do nothing.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile

from progressr.evaluate import with_progress
from progressr.progressor import progressor
from progressr.reporters import handler_ascii_alert

path = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), "alert.txt")
handle = open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
handler = handler_ascii_alert(symbol="!", file=handle, enable=True, intrusiveness=1)

def body():
    progress = progressor(steps=2, on_exit=False)
    progress(message="a")
    progress(amount=0, message="skip")
    progress(message="b")

with_progress(body, handlers=handler, enable=True, interval=0, delay_terminal=False, delay_stdout=False, delay_conditions=())
handle.close()
print(f"handler_ascii_alert wrote {len(open(path, encoding='utf-8').read())} bells.")
